reviews.t: Excellent accueil, pain et viennoiseries extra
Baguette, chocolad chad and pain au chocolat were delicious. They have plant based milk. Staff was very friendly and spoke english.

Very delicous pain au Chocolat .
Fair prices for paris.
Has also another cafe about 200 m up the street. Has a lot of diffrent options.
1.20€ pain au Chocolat
1.15€ Baguette
Nice bakery, friendly staff and great pain au chocolate! Can only recommend it!

I came for breakfast and also bought baguettes to have at night on my trip back home.
The pain au chocolat was good and buttery,  I always forget the name but I ordered this pastry filled with baked apple and was quite nice. The star of the show was the macaron, it tasted so fruty and nice!!! I loved it.
Baguettes were still good at night, lots of butter and good bread!
Pour le pain super, les viennoiseries bien, les gâteaux pourrais facilement faire mieux . mais le personnel super agréable efficace rapide souriante, les sandwichs sont très bien.💜💜💜💜
